decisions.decision: Users fill web application data forms; ISO documents are rendering templates only.
MVP manager signature is managed signature imagery, not automatically a legally certified PKI signature.
Authorization must be enforced server-side/database-side; UI role checks are not sufficient.
Phase-00 toolchain: Vite 8 + React 19 + TS strict + oxlint + Prettier + Vitest; npm as package manager; GitHub Actions for CI.
Repository workflow: feature branches with PRs for real features; main receives direct commits for foundation/config work.
Design direction: teal trung tính hóa từ DESIGN.md, không sao chép visual game UI; professional HR SaaS, light + dark.
Phase-01 UI stack: Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui (Radix primitives), CSS variables tokens, dark mode class strategy.

Microsoft 365 Outlook Integration Architecture: Approval Engine decoupled from Notification Adapters; MVP zero M365 Admin dependency via Basic Email Mode (deep link to LPVN Flow); Outlook Actionable Messages as progressive upgrade mode; secure anti-replay approval endpoints; snapshot approver identity & template versioning; ELECTRONIC_IMAGE vs DIGITAL_CERTIFICATE signature classification.

Engine Transition & Skill Optimization: Transitioned project agent engine from OpenCode to Antigravity AI Engine; re-cloned latest obra/superpowers and nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill into .agent/skills, .antigravity/skills, and .superpowers/skills; updated AGENT.md, SKILL.md, RULE.md, state.json for Antigravity native execution, subagent delegation, reactive wakeups, and artifact system.
